newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIANS UNFIT FOR WORLD CUP GAME - COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIANS UNFIT FOR WORLD CUP GAME - COACH.

text.p: Albania's squad will be under-strength and unfit for their World Cup group nine qualifier against Ukraine next Wednesday, coach Astrit Hafizi said on Tuesday.
Hafizi said players from domestic clubs were out of shape following the long league break caused by the recent civil unrest.
Albania's league was suspended in February and only resumed 10 days ago in a six-team play-off. The new season is scheduled to begin on September 13.
Of the 18-man squad, 11 players are based abroad -- mainly in neighbouring Greece, and Hafizi claimed they were not match fit either.
"Most of them have just returned from holidays or they are only just beginning with their physical preparation for the new league season," he grumbled.
"This is a bad moment for us to have a qualifier. Our team is not prepared. In Ukraine the league season has been underway for some time now.
"It will be a tough match. The Ukrainians will no doubt be fighting hard because if they win they will be qualified for France '98," he added.
Albania is wallowing at the bottom of the group with just one point from six matches while Ukraine lead with 14 from eight.
Missing from the squad is regular midfielder Bledar Kola. Hafizi said the Panathinaikos player did not answer any of his telephone calls or faxes.
Also absent is the injured Fatmir Vata, with Croatia's Samabor.
Hafizi also said he had received telephone threats to include certain players in the squad, but would not mention any names or details.
FIFA is due to decide this week whether Albania's September 10 home World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland can be played in Tirana.
The armed unrest in the Balkan country led FIFA to move all Albania's home ties to Spain. Matches against Germany and Ukraine were played there earlier in the year.
Goalkeepers - Fotaq Strakosha (Panionios, Greece), Blendi Nallbani (Apollon, Greece).

Defenders - Arjan Xhumba (Heraklis, Greece), Ilir Shulku (Apollon, Greece), Artan Daiu (Partizani, Albania), Artan Vila (Teuta, Albania), Alpin Gallo (Tirana, Albania), Afrim Tole (Partizani, Albania), Lulzim Hushi (Tirana, Albania).
Midfielders - Rudi Vata (Apollon, Cyprus), Alban Bushi (Apollon, Greece), Altin Haxhi (Panahaiki, Greece), Arjan Peco (Delemont, Switzerland), Ardian Mema (Partizani, Albania).
Forwards - Igli Tare (Fortuna Duesseldorf, Germany), Altin Rraklli (Unterhakin, Germany), Indrid Fortuzi (Tirana, Albania), Viktor Paco (Maribor, Slovenia).
